guides.title: Undead Warlock
guides.shortDescription: Deathknell, Brill, the early Warlock class quests, and planning for Silverpine and neighboring zones. A small preview, not a complete optimized route.
guides.description: Our first race/class route is being assembled from the researched Horde zones. These milestones demonstrate the guide-data system; precise quest batching, XP pacing, and zone transitions remain under review.

research.reason: Earlier preview needs reconciliation against the latest canonical research snapshot before a source snapshot can be claimed.

chapters.title: Deathknell
chapters.description: Starter-zone orientation and source-reported Imp quest.

steps.title: Begin your Undead journey
steps.description: Check the starter quest offers available to your character and complete local objectives. This is orientation, not a verified pickup order.

steps.title: Piercing the Veil
steps.description: If offered, collect 3 Rattlecage Skulls for Venya Marthand to learn Summon Imp. This is separate from the ordinary skeleton-kill quest.

chapters.title: Brill & Tirisfal
chapters.description: A future batched route will replace this planning note.

steps.title: Build an efficient quest batch
steps.description: Collect compatible Brill-area quests and group turn-ins when practical. Specific NPC locations and optimized sequence are still being reconciled.

chapters.title: Undercity · Warlock
chapters.description: Source-reported Voidwalker class chain. Complete only if the quests are offered.

steps.title: Halgar’s Summons
steps.description: At the source-reported minimum level 10, take the referral from Ageron Kargal in Brill to Carendin Halgar in Undercity, if offered.

steps.title: Creature of the Void
steps.description: Retrieve Egalin’s Grimoire from the Scarlet tower west of Undercity if this quest is available, then return to Carendin Halgar.

steps.title: The Binding
steps.description: Use the provided summoning runes at the ritual circle and defeat the Summoned Voidwalker if the quest is offered.
